scope_note: A chronological list of significant dates from the canon, separated into historical and future events relative to the 'as_of_in_canon' date.

historical_events.event: We The People Act 1 (WTP1) signed into law.
Solar Energy Initiative Act of 2001 signed into law.
Rail Access, Intercity Linkage, and System Renewal (RAILS) Act becomes effective.
We The People Act 2 (WTP2) signed into law.
We The People Act 3 (Supreme Court Reform Act) signed into law.
We The People Act 4 (WTP4) signed into law, strengthening beneficial ownership rules.
America First Forever Act (AFFA) signed, establishing durable trust funds.
Financial Stability Act of 2005 signed, pre-emptively regulating subprime markets.
National High-Speed Rail Act of 2006 signed, establishing a permanent HSR program.
McMillan Complex completed for the first session of the 110th Congress, though landscaping is ongoing.
CEPA and Gulf War Illness Recognition & Benefits Act signed into law.
President announces 'Make America Great Again — All of It' (MAGA AOI) and 'Make America Tax Free' (MATF) initiatives at SOTU.
SpaceX Strategic Integration Act signed into law.
A stability council takes power in North Korea, agreeing to stand down and begin reunification talks.

future_events.event: President delivers 'For All Mankind' speech to a Joint Session of Congress, outlining the 10-year U.S. Space Strategy, including AmeriSat, Project Artemis (Moon), the Mars Program, and Project Lariat (Skyhook).
Merchant Marine Modernization Act passes the Senate.
Major contracts for AmeriSat satellite bus manufacturing and communications payloads awarded.
AmeriSat Block 0 deployment scheduled to begin, providing initial service.
AmeriSat Block 1 deployment scheduled, aiming for full U.S. coverage.
AmeriSat Block 2 deployment scheduled, completing the constellation for global service.
Project Artemis Phase 2 (Crewed Sortie & Habitation) scheduled.
Project Lariat (Skyhook) scheduled to achieve Initial Operational Capability (IOC).
First unmanned cargo fleet to Mars scheduled.
First crewed landing on Mars scheduled.
